text:
Lina Patel: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — thanks for the deep dive. I'm listing consolidated action items here so we can track owners, blockers, and closure criteria. Please confirm or reassign.

Omar Ahmed: will do. can we add target SLAs for remediation? (eg: patches in this sprint, infra changes next)

Lina Patel: Yes — proposal: code fixes + tests in 2 wks, infra hooks (logging/alerting) in 3 wks, secrets rotation plan in 1 wk. Adjust if needed.

Priya Nair: I'll own permission scoping audit (who has write on /models/*). Deliverables: spreadsheet of principals, proposed role changes, and PR to org-iam. ETA: 2026-04-02. I'll mark high-risk principals. :mag:

Ethan Brooks: I'll take token validation regression fix + CI smoke. Plan: reproduce regression, add unit + e2e tests, and add pre-deploy smoke that runs token expiry/failure paths. ETA: 2026-03-29. Will include a feature flag for rollout.

InfraBot: Note: scheduled job created - nightly-auth-audit-20260324.

Priya Nair: Also adding an audit job that keeps anonymized failure samples for 45d. Storage: encrypted bucket, access by security only. Will produce a small schema doc.

Omar Ahmed: For secrets rotation: Ops should provide rotation window and a canary path. I can coordinate with infra to make the runbook.

Lina Patel: Owners checklist I have so far:
- Permission scoping & IAM cleanup: Priya (ETA 2026-04-02)
- Token validation fixes & CI smoke: Ethan (ETA 2026-03-29)
- Authz structured logs + retention: Omar (ETA 2026-04-05)
- Secrets rotation plan + dry-run: Security/Ops (ETA 2026-03-26)
- Runbook updates + rollback steps: Lina (ETA 2026-03-28)

Ethan Brooks: Quick note on the rollback toggle: we'll add `AUTHZ_VALIDATE_STRICT=false` as an emergency revert in the config service. I'll add playbook steps to disable and validate.

Priya Nair: Risk callout: changing IAM roles may break CI bots. I'll coordinate a pre-change window and list all build principals to exclude.

Omar Ahmed: Logging schema draft: include fields: outcome, failure_code, token_type, issuer, request_id, service, endpoint. Will open PR: git.internal/redwood/pull/8450 (WIP).

Lina Patel: Can we instrument a recurrence detector for auth regressions so leadership sees if a pattern re-emerges? e.g., alert when >=2 distinct regressions in 30d.

InfraBot: Alert rule template created: auth_regression_spike (requires review).

Omar Ahmed: Suggest monthly "Auth Health" retro — short review of incidents, outstanding remediation, and any drift in policies. Lina, can you own calendar invite?

Lina Patel: Yep — I'll schedule a 30m recurring for the first Friday of the month and keep it until we have 3 consecutive clean months. Invite: eng-security@redwood.

Ethan Brooks: I'll open the fix PRs and link here when ready. Also will add smoke test to the deploy pipeline (staging first).

Priya Nair: PR for IAM cleanup is in draft: git.internal/redwood/pull/8461. Will update with exception list and test plan.

Lina Patel: Closure criteria for the tracking ticket SEC-4821: (1) code fixes deployed with passing smoke tests, (2) audit log schema in prod for 7 days, (3) secrets rotation dry-run completed, (4) runbook updated and tested.

Omar Ahmed: Adding a small mitigation for now: stricter logging on token failures so we can triage faster. Deploying as config change only.

InfraBot: secrets-rotation-canary scheduled: 2026-03-26T03:00:00Z, job id rot-canary-20260326.

Lina Patel: Thanks all. Next sync: Mon 2026-03-23 09:00 PT for a 15m standup to confirm blocks. If anyone is delayed, drop an update in this thread. :calendar:
